partnerRows.required_fields: Choose lawyer, supplier, or both; keep this private.
partnerRows.ready_when: Owner knows whether the UK-law response requires a licensed lawyer, an external supplier, or a lawyer-led supplier.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not introduce the client or promise a match.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Choose first target type for the current UK-law demand.

partnerRows.required_fields: provider_type, supplier_category, service_area, jurisdictions, license_status, partnership_status, revenue_model, min_price, response_sla, contact route, source_url, owner_note.
partnerRows.ready_when: partnership_status=approved or at least candidate terms are documented for owner review.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not expose supplier publicly or send PII.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Create or complete a UK-law supplier candidate only after owner selects a real partner.

partnerRows.required_fields: practice_area=uk-law, city/coverage area, target_plan=lead_partner, license_verified, specialty_verified, agreed_lead_fee_ils, billing_contact_email, lead_fee_terms_ready, payment_path_ready.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not route as a paid lawyer lead while terms are incomplete.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Use if the first UK partner is a lawyer or a lawyer-led office.

partnerRows.admin_surface: CRM partner terms queue or partner record notes
partnerRows.required_fields: accepted service category, jurisdiction limits, response SLA, fixed price or lead fee, billing contact, VAT/invoice path, capacity limit, conflict/refusal rule.
partnerRows.ready_when: terms are accepted in writing and stored in wp-admin notes.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not release client PII or mark ready_to_bill.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Record partner terms before any handoff.

partnerRows.admin_surface: Justice CRM -> Anonymized partner preview / terms queue
partnerRows.required_fields: area=UK/cross-border law, source=/uk-lawyer/, general urgency, sanitized facts, no name/phone/email/documents/raw chat.
partnerRows.ready_when: client permission is recorded and preview text is safe.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not send screenshots, raw WhatsApp content or identifying details.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Use only after the client gives match permission.

partnerRows.admin_surface: Justice CRM -> Owner handoff release queue
partnerRows.required_fields: client permission, accepted partner terms, fee, billing contact, owner release note.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not hand off or remove routing hold without owner release.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Record manual-only release for the specific lead/partner pair.

partnerRows.admin_surface: Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue / Lawyer Onboarding payment follow-up
partnerRows.required_fields: invoice/reference or private payment evidence URL, billing status, owner note.
partnerRows.ready_when: invoice_sent has reference or paid has proof.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not claim revenue or mark paid without proof.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Use manual invoice path until payment provider proof exists.

partnerRows.admin_surface: Supplier public visibility / lawyer profile publication controls
partnerRows.required_fields: explicit public approval, source proof, approved status, offer summary, no business-plan language.
partnerRows.ready_when: Owner separately approves public display after legal/source review.
partnerRows.blocked_action: Do not publish supplier cards, public claims, pricing or paid placement language from this packet.
partnerRows.next_owner_action: Keep UK-law partner private for now.

templateRows.why: Invoices/payment requests need a real billing owner.
No partner PII handoff before client permission.
Final manual gate for this partner/lead pair.
